issue.title: Test Gap: test config in watchdog.yml for nexthop devices

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the test gap

In [`watchdog.yml`](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/0355934e7ab78910787da6c2fe754ec7c4507a2d/tests/platform_tests/api/watchdog.yml#L15), there are no test config values for nexthop devices. The default is also not compatible with nexthop devices.

### Affected Area

All of [test_watchdog.py](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/0355934e7ab78910787da6c2fe754ec7c4507a2d/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py) and nexthop devices

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

All of [test_watchdog.py](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/0355934e7ab78910787da6c2fe754ec7c4507a2d/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py) fail for nexthop devices

The default values are not compatible with the watchdog on nexthop devices (`x86_64-nexthop_4010-r.*`)

#### How did you do it?

Add test values compatible for testing nexthop devices.

#### How did you verify/test it?

Run sonic-mgmt `test_watchdog.py` on nexthop devices (`x86_64-nexthop_4010-r.*`). Make sure all tests in `test_watchdog.py` pass without causing additional test failures.
